headline: Google patches exploited Pixel zero-day in September update
summary: Two outlets report Google's September 2026 Pixel security update, which fixes a zero-day flaw. They differ on how firmly the exploitation is stated: one says the flaw was actively exploited in targeted attacks, the other reports Google saying there are indications it may be under limited, targeted exploitation.
